About.description: Game and full-stack developer with 4+ years of experience and founder of Kemet Studio. I build web games, content for the Steam community (my Wallpaper Engine backgrounds have passed 80 organic subscriptions) and custom software for real clients. I complement development with offensive security training, including Cisco's Ethical Hacker certification and CTF competitions, to build products that are both functional and secure.

antigua.desc: Built from scratch the custom themes for antiguatours.net and the Antigua Tours Weddings microsite platform, with tour and transfer bookings. Integrated and manage production payments with WooCommerce and Stripe (3D Secure, refunds, webhooks), custom-validated booking forms, and a 28+ tour catalog editable without touching code.

erp.desc: Led the Billing module in an institutional system for a real client. Full backend architecture and RESTful routing implementation.

buffalo.desc: Custom software design for stock management and logistics.

casaleyendas.desc: Technical coordination for the Casa de Leyendas mobile app, implementing multiplayer mechanics.

kemet.desc: Design, development and publishing of original web games (roguelike, multiplayer chess, arcade and simulation). Content creation for Steam Workshop: wallpapers with 80+ organic subscriptions and custom maps for Counter-Strike 2.

Games.text: One of my passions is videogames, so the road to creating the videogame of my dreams starts here

descriptions.description1: Test your memory and concentration in this matching game. Discover pairs of hidden cards as you try to solve the board in the shortest time possible.
descriptions.description2: Take control of a spaceship and face waves of alien enemies in a battle for survival.
descriptions.description3: A simple but challenging game that will keep you hooked for hours. Jump between obstacles and collect points while enjoying a relaxing but exciting experience.
descriptions.description4: Sow seeds, tend your crops and reap rewards as you adapt to the changing seasons.
descriptions.description5: Navigate the infinite space, dodging asteroids and earning points in this endless space survival game.
descriptions.description6: Dive into a unique chess game that combines classic strategy with elements of civilizations. Challenge your opponents while exploring different eras and cultures, each with its own pieces and special abilities.
descriptions.description7: Rougelike action game in the style of Vampire Survivors, set in the Mayan underworld. Survive 5 minutes against increasing waves of Camazotz bats, spectral jaguars, and skeletal warriors, level up, choose ancestral powers, and face Camazotz, the Bat Lord.
